verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators (USB, NFC, BLE HID devices implementing WebAuthn, FIDO2, U2F, PIV and OTP), not a web service with an HTTP API, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec does not fit this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows Feitian shipping a web API that would make this axis apply, and the probed OpenAPI paths all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
